title: Academic Calendar
facts: Year: Sem1 + Sem2 (16wks each incl. exams) + optional Summer (8wks incl. exams)
Bachelor: 4yrs standard (8 sems); max 8yrs; early finish allowed
Sems 1–4: common curriculum (all programs); Sem5+: specialization (CS/IS/IT/DS)
Levels by credit hrs: Freshman 0–36 | Sophomore 37–72 | Junior 73–108 | Senior 109–144
Field training: summer after Junior Sem2
Registration: opens pre-semester; late window: Week1; dean extension: before Week2 end
Withdrawal: no council→Week4 end | with College Council→Week12 end
Interruption: up to 2yrs (consec. or not) with approved excuse, submitted before/during sem
Absent 4yrs without excuse→dismissal (College Council + President approval required)
Summer counts toward academic warning calculation
Advisor assigned from enrollment to graduation

faq.q: Can I take a study break?
faq.a: Yes, up to 2yrs with College Council excuse (submitted before/during sem).

faq.q: What if I stop without excuse?

faq.a: Late reg: Week1. Dean extension: Week2. Withdrawal: Week4 (no council) or Week12 (with council).
